**The rail is a map of the document, and it scrolls with it.** Every card sits beside the text it is about, the rail is as tall as the page rather than as tall as the window, and scrolling the prose scrolls the cards with it — so reaching a thread means scrolling to the text it is on, and nothing is clipped, folded or summarised as "+N more". The settled and changed lists sit at the end of the map. A short line joins a card to its mark; a card with nothing to point at — which is every agent suggestion on its first paint, before the websocket catches up — sits after the map with no line at all. (Until 2026-08-16 the rail was a fixed column with five separate mechanisms managing the overflow that guaranteed; all five are gone. See `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-16-the-rail-scrolls.md`.)
